caption: A 7-segment display: four input lines (a 4-bit number) light the seven lamps of a readable digit on its front face, 0-9 then A b C d E F, with no flicker while the number changes (glitch-free). A chain of subtract comparators turns the four bits into one signal strength; two towers of dust rulers give every threshold; each run of values a segment lights is one subtract comparator between two taps of the same ruler; routed repeater lanes carry each segment to its lamp, with the inputs' delays equalised so every change arrives in the same tick. Catalog parts: comparator gates, repeater delays.
